architectural_boundaries: The Change Impact layer may consume Repository Intelligence exclusively through the Track 121 read-only Query Layer, consume Query Layer results, identify affected entities by deterministic declared criteria, and preserve attribution/limitations/boundary disclosures. architecture_summary: Defined the architecture for deterministic Repository Intelligence Change Impact analysis: identifying affected repository entities from existing Repository Intelligence, exclusively through the Track 121 read-only Query Layer, without recommendations or decision making.
